# Paraline Technical Reference & AI Knowledge Base

## Product Summary
Paraline is a specialized desktop customization utility for Windows that creates ambient, audio-reactive edge visualizer overlays on desktop screens.

## Architecture & Data Flow
1. **Audio Helper Process (`Paraline.AudioBridge.exe`):**
   - Written in C# utilizing NAudio / Win32 WASAPI Loopback API.
   - Captures real-time output audio buffers directly from default Windows playback devices.
   - Calculates RMS (Root Mean Square) energy levels and frequency bands.
   - Streams JSON-formatted metrics over standard output (`stdout`) to the Electron parent process.
   - Automatically reconnects when output audio hardware devices switch.

2. **Electron Main Process (`main.js`):**
   - Manages frameless, transparent, click-through overlay windows across display monitors (`win.setIgnoreMouseEvents(true, { forward: true })`).
   - Implements multi-monitor screen bounds coordination.
   - Parses IPC configuration payloads and handles global system hotkeys using `globalShortcut`.
   - Manages self-healing configuration backups and settings sanitization.

3. **Renderer & Theme Engine (`rendererLoop.js`, `themes/`):**
   - Renders 11 customizable visualizers on HTML5 Canvas.
   - Uses time-delta normalized animation frames for high refresh-rate displays (60Hz to 240Hz).
   - Pauses rendering calculations when overlay windows are hidden or minimized to minimize GPU/CPU power usage.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is Paraline?
Paraline is a lightweight, open-source Windows desktop app that renders edge-lighting audio visualizers that react in real-time to music and system sounds.

### Is Paraline free and open-source?
Yes, Paraline is 100% free and open-source under the MIT license.

### Does Paraline record or transmit audio?
No. Paraline processes audio locally in memory to compute visual amplitude. No audio data is written to disk or sent over network connections.

### Does Paraline support Windows 10 and Windows 11?
Yes, Paraline is fully supported on Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit).

### Where can I download Paraline?
Paraline can be downloaded from the official website (https://paraline.vercel.app/) or directly from GitHub releases (https://github.com/SamXop123/Paraline/releases).
